<a id="moldova-chisinau-service"></a>

### Serviciul de arhivă — Chișinău

`service-office` · [Website / directory](https://arhiva.gov.md/servicii-municipale-raionale-de-arhiva/)

The National Archives Agency lists the municipal or raion archive service for Chișinău. This is a local institutional route for identifying locally retained administrative or personnel records and the appropriate keeper. The directory does not establish custody of older Bessarabian or parish records; check the national archive and historical jurisdictions separately.

<a id="moldova-national"></a>

### Direcția generală Arhiva Națională

`repository` · [Website / directory](https://arhiva.gov.md/)

The National Archives Agency provides a government-archival-fund directory and a separate social-political route. Its published first-part directory covers 1420–1944; the agency also describes Bessarabian population-list inventories arranged by villages, volosts and districts. These are finding aids, not a guarantee that a particular household record is digitized.

Links: [https://arhiva.gov.md/fonduri-si-colectii/](https://arhiva.gov.md/fonduri-si-colectii/) · [https://arhiva.gov.md/lista-generala-a-fondurilor-si-colectiilor-agentiei-nationale-a-arhivelor-dgan/](https://arhiva.gov.md/lista-generala-a-fondurilor-si-colectiilor-agentiei-nationale-a-arhivelor-dgan/)

Holdings: Published first-part government-fonds directory; Bessarabian population-list inventory described by the agency.

Dates: Published first-part directory: 1420–1944; not the date range of every holding.

Source: [https://arhiva.gov.md/fonduri-si-colectii-2/](https://arhiva.gov.md/fonduri-si-colectii-2/) · 2026-11-02 · primary-page-discovered-in-search

## Coverage

Partial. Institution and branch lists are not fully reconciled. Unknown holdings, dates, languages and viewing conditions remain unknown. [Historical place lookup](../../historical/finding-a-volost.md).
